component.name: Camic
component.summary: Use your phone's camera and mic as a wireless webcam over Wi-Fi

description.p: Camic turns your phone into a wireless webcam and microphone for your computer. Start the app on both devices on the same Wi-Fi network, and your phone's camera appears as a normal webcam (OBS, Zoom, Meet, Teams) with its microphone available as a system audio input.

ul.li: Automatic device discovery over the local network (mDNS), no account or cloud
Up to 1080p H.264 video at low latency with live FPS/bitrate/loss stats
Virtual camera (v4l2loopback) and virtual microphone (PipeWire null-sink)
Works with OBS, browsers, and any app that can select a webcam
QR code / manual IP pairing with a one-time PIN

screenshot.caption: Camic streaming a phone camera with live FPS and bitrate stats

description.p: Linux: expose the virtual microphone as a real Audio/Source so it appears in browser microphone pickers (Chromium and Firefox used to hide the monitor source).
Initial release: wireless webcam and microphone from your phone.
